limitations: Core process only; no WebView, IPC, queue, PNG encode/decode or application thumbnail measurement.
Thumbnail-sized PPE render is not yet wired to sidebar; sidebar remains PDFium.
Counts/cache bytes are actual ResourceCache statistics; memory figures are sampled process working set/private at nominal 25ms, not exact whole-app lifetime peaks.
ABBA has only two samples per condition, not P95 or a corpus-wide non-regression claim.
The constrained run is RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1 with 1536/64 MiB budgets, not a physical low-RAM machine.

Before test binary includes only added tests/probe on base source. The measured after binary precedes a newline correction in the regression-test input; production code and benchmark code are identical.
Staged wheel was used via process-local PYTHONPATH and asserted before pytest. App EXE and installed PYD remain unchanged; UI automation permission is still pending.
No claim of completing the original architecture plan or release/installed smoke.
